## Location

Part number and file path:

## Problem type

- [ ] Incorrect technical statement
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Outdated tool/version note
- [ ] Missing prerequisite/build instruction
- [ ] Accessibility/documentation problem
- [ ] Licensing/source-status clarification
- [ ] Other

## Current text or behavior

Provide the smallest relevant excerpt or description.

## Proposed correction

Explain the correction and why it is more accurate.

## Evidence

Prefer official documentation, specifications, reproducible tests, or repository-local evidence. Do not paste copyrighted material beyond what is necessary to identify the issue.
